subject: RESUME statement
notes: VERDICTED CONFORMS by kb/Work PB892. RESUME AT NEXT STATEMENT's implicit CONTINUE: a) an exception-entered declarative returns -2 from __RunUse to the raise site, which completes the applicable statement - 1. the raising statement, 2. the CALL/INVOKE or the statement a function/inline invocation is written in (BoundActivationSite), 3. the lowest such statement. b) a declarative entered by a PERFORM in the nondeclarative portion (14.9.49.3 SR4) - 'the implicit CONTINUE statement immediately follows the last statement of the terminating procedure referenced in that PERFORM statement' - used to have NO landing: the ResumeSignal escaped every frame and the run unit died with an unhandled .NET exception (probe w48s/p6). BoundOutOfLinePerform.EntersDeclarative marks that PERFORM (range declarative, PERFORM not itself in a declarative) and ControlFlowEmitter.EmitPerformedRange catches ResumeSignal around the range: NEXT STATEMENT completes this execution of the range (the TIMES/UNTIL phrase goes on), procedure-name is GR3's GO TO. The golden covers TIMES, a SECTION range (the section's later paragraph is skipped), RESUME AT procedure-name, and the exception entry of the same declarative. The transcription dedents b) to column 0, so cite.py locates the b) text under '2) a) 3.'; it is GR2 b) in the printed standard. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/CodeGen/EmitterState.cs#OperandActivationResume (kb/Work PB1432 made the operand landing the ONE ResumeTransfer inside the operand-evaluation scope StatementEmitter.EmitStatement opens (OperandActivationResume became the private OperandEvaluationResume); the public method no longer exists)
